cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let me have the medal for the charity auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then it should raise more than the toaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for the display? I still want people to know I won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then present it to the buyer yourself. I'll print your name in the programme; everyone will know whose medal was worth giving up.

mechanism: A uses auction expertise to correct B substitute display offer and make surrender of a treasured medal seem like the professionally sound way to preserve recognition.
confusable: Simple pressure to donate lacks patient correction of sale, display and provenance roles.
comparison: Guitar alternative persuades through valuation and photographing a sentimental instrument rather than public charitable recognition.
seedUse: Medal seed supplies value and display compromise; S03 makes the differences between a loan and a sale explicit.
